metadata.dataset_name: AMDSF Synthetic Orbital Encounter Demonstration Dataset
metadata.label_generation_logic: Latent severity combines inverse miss distance (5.2 / (d + 1.15)), kinetic closing speed contribution, congested 500-900 km LEO debris-shell weighting, polar/SSO inclination factor, and Gaussian state-ephemeris uncertainty (sigma=0.22). Thresholds: <1.25 -> LOW RISK, 1.25..2.55 -> MEDIUM RISK, >=2.55 -> HIGH RISK.
metadata.warning: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATASET: Generated from physical risk heuristics for prototype ML evaluation; does not represent empirical space-catalog collision history.
